title: Quantum Sufficiency for Self-Adjoint Statistical Models via Likelihood-Type Operators on Real $*$-Subalgebras and Real Jordan Algebras
summary: We develop a theory of quantum sufficiency on real *-subalgebras and real Jordan algebras for models consisting of general self-adjoint operators, including derivatives of states. Square-root likelihood ratios and symmetric logarithmic derivatives serve as self-adjoint likelihood-type objects, allowing ordinary quantum statistical models and local models to be treated within a unified framework that admits degenerate reference states.
